reason: The UnloadingOperatorView UI queues status transition operations out-of-order with respect to the strict server-side Finite State Machine (FSM). During Start Unloading, the UI attempts to transition the status directly to 'OFFLOADED' while the server status is still 'AT_DESTINATION', which fails the server status validation check (only 'WEIGHED_DESTINATION' or 'REJECTED' is permitted). Similarly, during Complete Unloading, it transitions directly to 'COMPLETED' from 'WEIGHED_DESTINATION', bypassing 'OFFLOADED' status check requirements.

Server FSM validation throws error since transition AT_DESTINATION to OFFLOADED is disallowed

onlineOfflineConvergence.proof: Both paths construct the same clientRecord in-memory representation, write to local IndexedDB cache, queue in the outbox, and only diverge by synchronously replaying via syncAll() when online or deferring replay when offline.
